title: Kanda 5: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 5.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 5.

verses.original: उत्तष्ठेतो मनुष्या माव पत्था मृत्योः पड्बीशमप नुदस्व । मा च्छित्था अस्मिल्लोकेऽमुष्मिन् शतशारदाय जीव ॥
verses.transliteration: uttaṣṭheto manuṣyā māva patthā mṛtyoḥ paḍbīśamapa nudasva | mā cchitthā asmilloke'muṣmin śataśāradāya jīva ||
verses.translation: Rise up from here, O mortal! Do not fall; cast aside the shackles of death! Be not cut off from this world; live a full hundred autumns of radiant vitality!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Ayushya hymn: divine life-force vanquishing illness and despair, blessing the human soul with a hundred-year lifespan.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Rise up from here, O mortal! Do not fall; cast aside the shackles of death! Be not cut off from this world; live a full hundred autumns of radiant vitality!
